{{Quote|T'doshok no surrender!|T'doshok|<ref name="Out Foxed" />}}
'''T'doshok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatist faction]] that had seceded from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government. He had planned to capture Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Shayla Paige-Tarkin]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to give her over to the Separatists in exchange for a large [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]]; however, he was intercepted by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]] and the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], a group of specially trained [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] attached to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. Though he tried to run, the Trandoshan was quickly disarmed by the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and arrested.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Give it up, There's no way you'll make it out of my town alive. Surrender now and I promise you that you'll live.|Clone Commander Fox, to T'doshok|<ref name="Out Foxed" />}}
T'doshok, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]],<ref name="TERC" /> tried to capitalize on the large [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for [[Senator/Legends|members]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] offered by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between them and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], in an attempt to capture Senator [[Shayla Paige-Tarkin]]. Espionage brought news of his plan to [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]], leader of a task force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] called the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] charged with defending the Senate and its members. Fox knew of him before his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] had landed and he mobilized a trooper unit to confront T'doshok with orders to take him alive.<ref name="Out Foxed" />

[[File:CommanderFox.png|thumb|right|200px|Fox (pictured) pursued T'doshok in an attempt to apprehend him.]]
Upon seeing Fox, alone, the bounty hunter attacked with his [[Accelerated Charged Particle Array Gun/Legends|ACP scatter gun]]. T'doshok's initial shots missed and he took shelter behind an old [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]], a position from which he let a volley go that barely missed Fox's head. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] raised his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and took aim, but did not fire as that would have breached his objective. His target fled through the streets. Fox gave chase and [[Comlink/Legends|contacted]] his team. The clones quickly surrounded the T'doshok who, with nowhere else to run, used his hidden [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] to fly to a nearby rooftop. Fox used an [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension gun]] to scale the building and climb to the roof while the Trandoshan fired at him. The clone took cover and fired several warning shots before telling T'doshok to surrender.<ref name="Out Foxed" />

The bounty hunter refused and squeezed the trigger of his gun. However, Fox took advantage of the Trandoshan [[Species/Legends|species]]' naturally slow firing rate and shot the gun out of the [[Alien/Legends|alien's]] hands. Fox once again told the bounty hunter to surrender, but the commander noticed that he was looking for a way to escape. He threatened to shoot the Trandoshan out of the sky if he tried to use his jetpack again. T'doshok knew that he had lost, so he gave in and was taken into custody by the Guard.<ref name="Out Foxed" />

==Personality and traits==
T'doshok, a male Trandoshan, worked as a bounty hunter in the galaxy and had [[Color/Legends|brown]] scales and orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The bounty hunter was willing to attempt a bounty that no-one had ever collected successfully as a quick way to a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. When he was confronted by Fox, he became visibly nervous, but he refused defiantly to surrender and opened fire on the clone. T'doshok showed that he was not very accurate with his blaster, though some of his shots nearly hit their mark. The tenacious bounty hunter only surrendered, reluctantly, to Fox's men when there was no chance of escape.<ref name="Out Foxed" />

==Skills and abilities==
The Trandoshan knew at least some of his native language, [[Dosh/Legends|Dosh]]. He could also speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], though not well grammatically. T'doshok had a slow trigger finger, which was not uncommon for his species.<ref name="Out Foxed" />

==Equipment==
The bounty hunter was armed with an ACP scatter gun as his primary [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]]. He also carried a jetpack on his back for quick escapes.<ref name="Out Foxed" />

==Behind the scenes==
T'doshok appeared in the four-page [[eBook]] "[[Out Foxed]]" by [[Rob Valois]], published in [[2008]]. In the story, he uttered the phrase "T'doshok no surrender,"<ref name="Out Foxed" /> which may have been a reference to his species, as the [[2003]] reference work ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' stated that that is the name for the species in their native language.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> This would have aligned with his species' backstory, as they worshiped a deity called the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]], who tallied [[Jagannath point/Legends|''jagannath'' points]] for everything a Trandoshan hunter did. Trandoshans did not surrender because to be caught alive or shamed meant that the Scorekeeper would reset an individual's tally and invalidate their life's work.<ref name="The Prize Pelt: The Tale of Bossk">{{StoryCite|story=The Prize Pelt: The Tale of Bossk|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> However, [[2012|four years later]], ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] stated in a small ''dramatis personae'' for the short story that this was the bounty hunter's name,<ref name="TERC" /> so he was speaking in the third person.<ref name="Out Foxed" />
